_comment: OPS-THRESHOLD-CLOCK-W1 — SHRINK-ONLY baseline for scripts/check-threshold-clock.py. Each row is pre-existing debt: a dated revisit clock kept in prose (kind=clock), or a paging-canary comparison against a module-level numeric threshold with no self-running revisit (kind=threshold). Retire a clock by registering it as an ops/monitoring/owed-reads.json row; retire a threshold with `# threshold-revisit: <id>` or a reasoned `# threshold-exempt:` on its assignment. `--write-baseline` only ever removes rows. There is no flag that adds one.
